blockers.wanted: a splash whose centroid falls over time (broadband burst then a bubbling tail)
blockers.tried: splash size 0.12 and 0.06 alone; then splash + water with a falling flow
blockers.workaround: own burst (noise x fast decay through an exp-falling lp), tail = poisson (falling rate) -> voices of bubbles whose radius grows with $t, times a decay. The splash node is kept at a low gain just for the cavity bubble. splash alone read centroid 605 Hz rising to 3.7 kHz (dominated by the ~240 Hz cavity bubble at 0.12 m, cloud brighter than the start); water with a falling flow also rises in centroid since low flow means small, high bubbles. No field on splash or water for burst level, cloud decay or cloud brightness.

blockers.wanted: to know the amplitude scale of loudness
blockers.tried: loudness 0.5 in voices gave a +14 dBFS peak for the summed bubbles; 0.03 landed near 0.5
blockers.workaround: found by trial with listen node:bub

blockers.wanted: put a fixed duration back to auto length
blockers.tried: duration: null (leaves it unchanged); duration 0 works but is not documented

blockers.wanted: a punch macro whose crest claim passes
blockers.tried: burst gain, burst decay time, tail gain: crest with peak_db output stayed ~26-30 dB and non-monotonic because one start sample sets the peak and the 0.5 ms-2 ms output fade_in changes it; lufs claim also failed because the peak normalizer masks the tail gain. Settled on a claim of centroid -1 for the tail knob (named bubbles).

blockers.wanted: a hit that starts at sample 0 without losing level
blockers.tried: fade_in 0 fails silent_edges (first sample -28 dBFS); default 2 ms cuts the peak by 1.4-2 dB with a warning that says set fade_in 0 which then fails verify

wishlist: splash fields: burst level, cloud density/decay, cloud brightness (or a bubble_cloud node with size growing over time)
a way to make the voices map expressions clamp ($t past a window gave a negative loudness error only on auto-length)
document bubble loudness scale and fade_in vs silent_edges interplay
what_worked: poisson -> voices of bubble with $rand/$t radius gave a controllable bubbling tail
macros on node fields with claim sweeps in verify told me quickly which knobs lied
duration 0 auto length plus listen centroid by tenth showed the falling centroid
